stemMd: A reaction has a theoretical product yield of 12 g and an isolated yield of 9 g. What is the percentage yield?
explanationMd: Percentage yield is actual yield divided by theoretical yield, multiplied by 100. Thus 9/12 × 100 = 75%. The result is below 100% because less product was isolated than the maximum predicted.

distractorRationale.b: This is the percentage shortfall, not the percentage obtained.
distractorRationale.e: This inverts actual and theoretical yields.
distractorRationale.a: This confuses the mass difference with a percentage.
distractorRationale.d: Multiplying the two masses does not give a yield percentage.
